content.title: MmOrganized
content.description: An AI-powered, multi-tenant, full-stack Next.js application with secure authentication (Google & GitHub OAuth), payment gateway integration (Razorpay), and real-time notifications (using Pusher). Motion (Framer Motion), Shadcn UI, Drizzle ORM, Better Auth, and Lucide React were used to speed up development. New users get limited free credits to try it out!

content.title: ghsync-gui
content.description: A GUI app built with Electron to back up your GitHub repositories into your local machine with a single click. Supports Git LFS, automatic dark and light mode and ignoring specific repos.

content.title: The Stellar Expedition
content.description: A skill-based space exploration game made with Godot. Features realistic gravity physics, real-time orbital trajectory prediction, a custom particle system for the rocket thruster, various planets, with gas planets having a drag force, and cryptographic data hashing and validation to prevent cheating. Available on the browser, Windows, Linux, and Android. Click the link below to play without installing or download the game for free.
